identity: Frozen historical-center, deterministic mean-feedback jet sensitivity; no training or eta update

source.condition_identity: Historical data, not a PPO batch; j and xbar_j are fixed public policy conditions shared by all comparisons
source.hash_convention: sha256/protocol_sha256/script_sha256 hash UTF-8 text after CRLF-to-LF normalization; byte hashes are separate
source.portability_repair: Line-ending-only fingerprint repair after first computation; no numerical design or result changed and no response matrices recomputed.

frozen_settings.input_normalization: v_j=sqrt(dt)*delta_w_j, sum v_j^2 equals sampled disturbance energy
frozen_settings.Gaussian_action_formula: latent a~Normal(mu,.35^2 I); actual stochastic u=U*tanh(a)
frozen_settings.meaning_of_Gamma: Finite-horizon induced L2 gain squared of task-weighted incremental outputs, not infinite-horizon H-infinity stability or exact full nominal task cost change

local_model.model_identity: Externally specified q=0 linearization and exact ZOH; not identified from five-step data
local_model.offset_identity: Historical alignment including old disturbance/model defect, not future privileged information

policy_identities.mixed_dK_deta: identity on all 12 physical Jacobian coordinates, analytically D*D^-1=I at every center
policy_identities.score_claim_scope: Every fixed recorded-center density is eta-independent for any latent action and fixed advantage; not a claim about new off-center rollouts
policy_identities.stochastic_vs_deterministic: Gamma uses U*tanh(mu), not E[U*tanh(a)] under the Gaussian; no guarantee is transferred between them
policy_identities.sample_policy_gradient_identity: Deduced for any fixed advantages from eta-invariant recorded-center density; not a computed old PPO advantage gradient
policy_identities.fisher_identity: Exact conditional Fisher sum J_mu.T Sigma^-1 J_mu, not an empirical covariance of the four fixed residual probes

adjoint.note: Eigenvector is the induced-norm definition, not an adversarial physical rollout or selected disturbance amplitude

symbolic_cases.rho_less_than_allow: Every normalized disturbance in the ball satisfies the stated linearized facet budgets
symbolic_cases.rho_equal_to_allow: At least one worst direction can attain a limiting facet in the linearized model
symbolic_cases.rho_greater_than_allow: There exists a direction violating a linearized facet; not every direction and not actual hardware violation

capacity.input_scope: Conservative first-order budget for historical input slack; tanh already enforces actual hardware bounds
capacity.planner_scope: Readout for the fixed old local plan; no MPC, dual, plan update or chosen disturbance radius

remove_center.meaning: Breaks the nominal-null condition; not a performance comparator

task_cost_scope.conditional_upper_bound: DeltaJ <= 2*sqrt(Jnom)*sqrt(Gamma)*rho + Gamma*rho^2 for this fixed nominal, local response and energy ball

preconditioner_fact.claim: No linear M maps the zero fixed-center nominal sample gradient to a nonzero gain gradient
preconditioner_fact.does_not_rule_out: Model-based robust policy gradients, same-disturbance PPO data, objective changes or standard optimization

budget.FD_interpretation: 48 fixed coordinate probes only for derivative precision, no gain tuning or candidate selection

limits: Derivatives are externally supplied, not identified by the one historical trajectory.
Mean-feedback sensitivity does not prove stochastic rollout risk or stochastic-to-deterministic transfer.
Five-step local induced gain does not prove infinite-horizon stability, robust nonlinear safety or global performance.
No feedback parameter was updated, no plan was changed and no improved learned capability was executed.
Nominal zero score is conditional on these fixed centers; sufficiently excited on-policy data can provide ordinary PPO with off-center feedback credit.
The gain is incremental task-weighted energy, not the full nonzero-nominal worst-case task cost; the cross term is retained explicitly.
